answer.justification: Every logit-level measurement is exactly at its identity value: top-1 and sequence agreement are 1.000, KL, TV and Token-DiFR gap are 0.000, and raw-score shift ÷ TV is undefined (0 ÷ 0). Quantized models show KL 0.039 or higher and top-1 agreement of at most 0.955. Fine-tuned and system-prompted models are further from the reference still. Output and activation levels were not measured, but any real change would already show up as a non-zero logit difference, so the unknown model is the reference itself.
